target_customer: Founders and sales or marketing teams who want Reddit leads (current); creators and small businesses wanting a Notion-style site (original product)
problem: Current: finding people on Reddit asking for relevant products and reaching out personally. Original: turning Notion-style pages into branded websites without code.
product_category: No-code website builder, later AI Reddit lead generation

founders.name: Miha Mlakar
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder of Tingles (YC W18) and Popsy.

founders.name: Mourad Mourafiq
founders.background_notes: YC page bio says he loves building products; one search snippet lists him with Tingles, but the YC page attributes Tingles to Miha.

competitors.name: Simple.ink
competitors.what: Notion-to-website builder that offers migration from Popsy

technical_complexity.rationale: A site builder with a Notion-like editor is standard web engineering; Reddit DM automation is mostly API and LLM integration.

defensibility.rationale: Many Notion-site tools existed and Reddit outreach tooling is easy to copy.

market_need_then: Notion users in 2022 wanted custom-domain public sites; Product Hunt launch drew reviews averaging 3.7 across 10.

branding.domain_note: Product originally at popsy.co; current site popsy.ai (the fetched popsy.ai root returned 404 on one attempt).
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch with mixed reviews; a Product Hunt post complained that hundreds of Popsy sites had been down for months and founders were unreachable (single user claim).

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand-specific press; user complaints on Product Hunt suggest weak trust.

pivots.from: Website builder with a Notion-style editor
pivots.to: AI tool that finds Reddit leads and sends personalized DMs
pivots.why: Not stated in sources found; YC page shows both the old launch post and the new description.

outcome_analysis: Popsy began as a Notion-style website builder, then moved to an AI Reddit lead tool with a two person team. No priced round or exit was found and users reported stability and support problems, so the story is unresolved; it is listed Active but with thin evidence of traction.
notes: Seedtable shows a $500K pre-seed in 2022 from a single aggregator, probably the standard YC deal; recorded as unverified, not a round. Extruct revenue figure of $21.4M looks wrong and is ignored. Product Hunt launch date conflicts (Sept vs Nov 2022). Competition list is thin; only one dated rival with no date source. Searches found no acquisition or shutdown report. Completeness pass: the $500K 2022 pre-seed rests on Seedtable alone (exact date not shown).
